summary: Kawartha Highlands Provincial Park is verified as a southern Ontario park focused on backcountry canoeing and camping with online reservations. The claim that hiking is strictly limited was corrected to reflect the 'short hike' opportunities mentioned in official literature. Airport and cellular data claims remain unverified due to absence in the provided source.
